item.title: Tamil Nadu: 10 Killed, 20 injured in head-on collision between two buses | Dynamite News
item.description: A tragic accident occurred in Tamil Nadu’s Sivaganga district when two government buses collided head-on near Kummangudi. At least 10 people lost their lives, and 20 others sustained injuries.

item.title: Parliament Winter Session 2025 Begins: Govt to table 10 Bills amid rising Opposition heat | Dynamite News
item.description: India’s Parliament begins its Winter Session today, expected to be intense and politically charged. The government plans to introduce 10 significant bills, while the opposition is set to demand discussions on election-related issues, SIR, and accountability in recent controversies.

item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Monday, 1 December—politics, crime, sports, and more—all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Cyclone Ditwah: Last batch of stranded Indians evacuated from Sri Lanka under ‘Operation Sagar Bandhu’ | Dynamite News
item.description: India has completed the evacuation of all stranded Indian citizens in Sri Lanka after Cyclone Ditwah triggered severe floods. Under ‘Operation Sagar Bandhu’, the Indian Air Force and commercial airlines coordinated multiple rescue flights from Colombo.

item.title: GDP boost sends Markets soaring: Sensex–Nifty hit record highs; 10 Stocks turn into rockets | Dynamite News
item.description: India’s stock market skyrocketed on Monday as stellar GDP growth figures propelled Sensex and Nifty to fresh all-time highs. The benchmark indices opened with explosive momentum, with Sensex touching 86,159 and Nifty hitting 26,325.

item.title: Delhi shivers as temperature drops below normal; Air quality slips to ‘Very Poor’ at AQI 301 | Dynamite News
item.description: Delhi witnessed a sharp dip in temperature on Monday, with the minimum settling at 5.7°C, over 4 degrees below normal, marking the season’s lowest. Meanwhile, the city’s air quality deteriorated again, recording an overall AQI of 301 in the ‘very poor’ category.

item.title: Winter Session Begins: PM Modi tells opposition; “No drama, only delivery in Parliament” | Dynamite News
item.description: Ahead of the Winter Session of Parliament, Prime Minister Narendra Modi sent a sharp message to the Opposition, urging them to focus on constructive debate instead of disruption. He stressed that Parliament is meant for policy and national progress, not drama or political frustration.

item.title: Gold, Silver prices skyrocket in India today; Check rates here | Dynamite News
item.description: On December 1, gold and silver prices witnessed significant gains in domestic and MCX markets. 24-carat gold rose to ₹13,048 per gram, 22-carat to ₹11,960, and 18-carat to ₹9,786, while silver jumped to ₹1,88,000 per kg.

item.title: Emotional Dharmendra breaks down at daughter Esha’s vidaai; Viral video resurfaces | Dynamite News
item.description: A heart-touching video of veteran actor Dharmendra breaking down during his daughter Esha Deol’s vidaai in 2012 has resurfaced following his death on November 24. The clip captures the emotional father-daughter bond as Dharmendra struggles to let go.

item.title: Parliament Winter Session: Lok Sabha adjourned till 2 PM amid Opposition protests over SIR | Dynamite News
item.description: The Lok Sabha was adjourned till 2 PM as opposition MPs raised slogans against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The Winter Session 2025, running from December 1 to 19, is the shortest session under the Modi government.
